requirements_summary: Short: need agent-assist + automated summaries + tool-calling for CRM actions. Must tolerate incident bursts and seasonal peaks (holiday spikes). Targets: p50 <50ms token lat, p95 <120ms, p99 <250ms on typical agent flows; sustain 150 rps sustained for regional cluster, allow 3x bursts to 600 rps for up to 10 min. Must maintain ordering/consistency for ticket updates during backpressure. Must support prefix caching, warm-model pools, and graceful fallback to a smaller quantized variant under capacity constraints. Cost sensitivity: want predictable monthly caps and intelligent batching to reduce per-token costs. Security: SSO (SAML), SCIM sync, audit logs, KMS.
